# 【PRAGMATA】Sector 03: TERRA DOME!! ⚠️SPOILER ALERT⚠️

## ⚡ Quick Stream Highlights (TL;DR)
- Kobo Kanaeru played 'PRAGMATA,' encountering persistent lag while exploring new areas and delving deep into game mechanics and story progression.
- She expressed admiration for fellow VTuber Kobo Kanaeru, even identifying herself as 'a Kobo,' and engaged in various fan interactions.
- The stream featured intense combat scenarios, including a boss fight victory, alongside humorous reactions to in-game events and technical glitches.
- Kobo Kanaeru shared personal anecdotes, reflections on childhood and fatherhood, and discussed JKT48, providing a mix of gameplay and zatsudan.
- The broadcast concluded with gameplay, an outro, and a humorous dismissal of a failed AI character, promising a return stream.

## ⭐ Standout Stories & Timestamps
- **[⏱️ 00:05:40](#t=00:05:40) Identifying as 'a Kobo'**: Kobo Kanaeru expresses her admiration for herself (Kobo Kanaeru) and her content, stating, 'Yes, I'm a Kobo. Thank you.'
- **[⏱️ 00:18:49](#t=00:18:49) Auto Hack Realization**: After initial confusion, Kobo Kanaeru has a breakthrough in understanding the game's 'auto hack' mechanic, exclaiming, 'Oh, it's an auto hack. Okay, okay, okay. I see, I see. That's how you auto bro.'
- **[⏱️ 01:20:49](#t=01:20:49) Bizarre Game Dialogue Mishearing**: During an in-game cutscene, Kobo Kanaeru humorously mishears a critical plot point, reacting to a character being told, 'You're pregnant. That same power lies within you, Diana,' likely a mishearing of 'Pragmata.'
- **[⏱️ 01:34:40](#t=01:34:40) Rejection of Fatherhood**: Kobo Kanaeru comically and emphatically states her disinterest in being called 'papa' or becoming a father, saying, 'Don't call me papa. I am not a father... I don't want to be a dad.'
- **[⏱️ 01:40:02](#t=01:40:02) Appreciate Your Father**: Moved by the background music in an in-game video, Kobo Kanaeru shares a heartfelt message to viewers: 'Love your father while he's still around, guys.'
- **[⏱️ 01:46:18](#t=01:46:18) Kobo Kanaeru and JKT Fan Comment**: Kobo Kanaeru reads a fan's comment suggesting that Kobo Kanaeru would be suitable for JKT48's 'funky Dream team' and 'cute Love team' if she were to join.
- **[⏱️ 02:18:41](#t=02:18:41) Boss Defeated**: After an intense and challenging battle, Kobo Kanaeru triumphantly declares victory, exclaiming, 'complete GG, guys. It's a GG. It's a freaking GG.'
- **[⏱️ 02:30:26](#t=02:30:26) Humorous Take on a Failed AI Character**: In the stream's final moments, Kobo Kanaeru humorously dismisses a failed in-game character ('eight') as an 'AI bot' whose 'data will be everywhere in the cloud,' adding that she 'didn't end up having any more children.'

After giving her final 'Otsu' and 'Kaeru' salutations, she mentioned a 'next pragmant stream' and briefly considered raiding another streamer before concluding the broadcast, promising to see viewers again at 3 AM.
